title: Process Activity event (process-tree telemetry for containment and post-incident review)
summary: OCSF Process Activity events for endpoint process lineage. ransomware_containment reads process creation and termination to identify the encrypting process and confirm it is stopped; post_incident_review reconstructs the execution chain from the artifacts responders left behind, so the timeline rests on observed process events rather than recollection. Consumed only.
sources: OCSF v1.4.0 System Activity category — Process Activity class (uid 1007)
